# Schloss Karlsberg — 3D reconstruction (living document)

Sub-project of the Saar LiDAR Explorer: a researched, georeferenced 3D reconstruction of
Schloss Karlsberg near Homburg (Duke Karl II. August of Pfalz-Zweibrücken, built 1778–1788,
burnt 1793) and all buildings of the residence, plus plan documents (Flurplan/Lageplan,
Grundrisse, Ansichten, Schnitte). Goal: "discover the castle" — fly over it and walk into it,
first in a standalone viewer, later as a layer in the explorer map.

**Status:** Phases 1–4 done: research (docs 01–08), catalogue v2 (`model/catalogue.json`, generated by `scripts/catalogue-v2/`), procedural generator (exteriors, interiors of 7 buildings, 1789 site), standalone viewer, 30 plan sheets. Review 1 is processed (fix round 1: 20 of 22 issues handled, see `docs/review/review-1.md`). Explorer integration (castle side) done: light layer `pnpm run export:explorer` → `../app/public/data/shared/karlsberg1789/` and camera handover in both directions (`docs/explorer-integration.md`). Everything is a **hypothesis** with evidence tags (D, D->, I, N, U, HMS) and a confidence level per building.

## Run
```bash
cd schloss-karlsberg && pnpm install && pnpm run dev     # viewer → http://localhost:5260/
pnpm run test      # vitest (model, plans, viewer): 209 tests
pnpm run build     # tsc --noEmit + vite build
pnpm run plans     # 30 sheets → plans/out/*.svg|pdf, previews → docs/plans-preview/
pnpm run export    # glTF per building (lod0/lod1) + site → model/out/
pnpm run export:explorer   # light layer for the explorer → ../app/public/data/shared/karlsberg1789/ (glb + footprints + index)
pnpm exec tsx scripts/catalogue-v2/build.ts   # rebuild model/catalogue.json (deterministic)
cd ../pipeline && uv run python -I ../schloss-karlsberg/scripts/prepare-terrain.py   # viewer terrain (1789 + 2025)
```

**Viewer keys:** click the canvas for mouse look (pointer lock) · WASD / arrows move · Q/E (PageDown/PageUp) down/up in Fliegen · Space jump in Gehen · Shift fast · F Fliegen · G Gehen · M Zurück zur Karte (explorer at the same pose). The panel has "Gehe zu" places and rooms, time of day, shadows, confidence colours, roofs, interiors, low-confidence hypotheses and terrain (1789 hypothesis / DGM 2025). Clicking a building opens its catalogue entry. Test hooks: `window.skb` (`goto`, `step`, `set`, `gpuBench`, `handover`, `backUrl`). Opened from the explorer with `?src=explorer&E=…&N=…&h=…&heading=…&pitch=…&mode=fliegen|gehen&back=…`, it starts at that pose (`docs/explorer-integration.md`).

## Principles
- **Evidence first.** Every building/part carries a confidence level and its sources
  (historic plans, views, excavations, LiDAR remains, comparable buildings). Where we infer,
  we say so. The model is a *hypothesis*, not a record.
- **Georeferenced.** EPSG:25832, heights DHHN2016, local frame as in `../docs/data-contract.md`
  (`x = E − E0`, `y = h`, `z = −(N − N0)`, karlsberg AOI origin E0 = 381000, N0 = 5465000),
  true heights, so the model drops into the explorer without transforms.
- **Heritage law.** The site is a protected monument (SDschG Saarland / DSchG RLP). The model
  and plans are for looking, not for digging; no detector or excavation guidance.
- **Data/media out of git.** Downloaded videos, frames, Video2World outputs and big binaries
  stay in git-ignored folders; only sources, specs and small derived docs are committed.

## Layout
| Folder | Content |
|---|---|
| `research/` | history & sources, comparable palaces, LiDAR site analysis (`lidar_features.geojson`), Video2World feasibility |
| `scripts/catalogue-v2/` | catalogue builder (buildings, room programmes, terrain features, DTM samples) |
| `model/` | `catalogue.json` + generator: `src/layout` (single layout truth: frame, storeys, bays, openings, walls), `src/exterior`, `src/interior`, `src/site`, `src/materials`; tests in `model/tests` |
| `viewer/` | standalone three.js viewer (Fliegen + Gehen), terrain in `viewer/public/terrain` |
| `plans/` | Lagepläne, Grundrisse, Ansichten, Schnitte (SVG/PDF via headless Chrome) |
| `scripts/` | `prepare-terrain.py` (1789 terrain: levelled features, building aprons), `export-glb.ts`, `fetch-textures.sh`, `dev/` diagnostics (`ray.ts` raycasts through facade openings, `warn.ts` interior warnings) |
| `docs/` | `architecture.md`, `explorer-integration.md` (light layer + camera handover), `review/` (reviews + fix notes), `screenshots/`, `plans-preview/` |
| `video2world/` | video → 3D experiment (inputs/outputs git-ignored) |

  - TF-09 parterre at 345.9 (was 347.39), below the CdL EG floor 346.2; 2-step garden perron. The parterre is laid out on the palace axis and clipped to its polygon.
  - 1789 terrain: footprints clamped under the lowest floor, 3 m aprons at the adjacent level. B10 W foot 335.2, B06 court 344.8 flat to the plinth.
  - Splayed deep reveals; interiors cull buried openings like the exterior. A test checks that every interior reveal lies in its exterior hole (7 buildings).
  - B02 head: 4-column portico with balcony and an 11-step Freitreppe (3D + AN-01).
  - Matte slate (roughness 0.88), sandstone chimneys 0.9×0.6 m, dark grey-green shutters, room-env mirrors (roughness 0.35), greener meadows, lobed and varied tree crowns.
  - Plans: GR-01 Vestibül columns from the interior model, dashed flights above the cut; LP-03 avenues in their own style; AN-04 labels B14 as Kellerfront.
  - Numbers: 179 tests; view-west 6.5 ms GPU, 820 calls, 4.36 M triangles (trees +1.4 M); JS heap 445 MB.
- 2026-11-01 — explorer integration, castle side (`docs/explorer-integration.md`):
  - Viewer dev server moved from 5250 to **5260** (preview 5261), because 5250 is the explorer's `serve:local`.
  - `pnpm run export:explorer` writes the light layer `sle-recon-v1` to `../app/public/data/shared/karlsberg1789/`:
    - `buildings.glb` 4.64 MB: 92 nodes, 340 k triangles. LOD1 exteriors without window frames and ironwork. Vertex colours plus a per-vertex `_CONF` (confidence). Base skirts reach ≥ 0.5 m below the 2025 DTM. Compressed with meshopt.
    - plus `footprints.geojson` and `index.json`.
  - Pure helpers are in `model/src/explorer/export.ts`. New dev dependencies, exact pins: `@gltf-transform/core|extensions|functions` 4.5.1 and `meshoptimizer` 1.3.0.
  - Viewer handover (`viewer/src/handover.ts`):
    - Explorer pose from the query string, in mode fliegen (exact pose) or gehen (nearest entrance within 200 m).
    - "← Zurück zur Karte" button and key M return to the explorer. The target is the validated local `back` URL, with hash fields 1–5 replaced by the current pose.
    - 30 new tests (209 in total).
